style: Cinematic sci-fi, dramatic rim lighting, metallic surfaces, rugged work gear. Earth tones and charcoal with bright hazard-yellow accents and warm amber glow.
notes: Rewrite (2026-10). Images 1, 2, 4 and 5 are kept from the 2025 page; their prompts are the originals, trimmed, kept as a record and not meant to be regenerated (the preset is the closest match to how they look). Image 3 was regenerated because the old one was a holographic HUD with words on it: gen "HazardMissionTeam (2)" --only 3, then finish "HazardMissionTeam (2)" --only 3.

images.prompt: Wide low shot of four humanoid androids in protective suits with glowing orange visors working together in a crystalline underground cavern: one drilling, one carrying building blocks, one with a holographic tablet, one with rescue gear.
Elevated shot of an android response team running a rescue during a storm: hover platforms, yellow utility vehicles and an excavator around a collapsing settlement, civilians being led to safety.

Side-view cross-section of a hillside and the ground beneath it, like an ant farm. On the surface, a small frontier base of prefab huts, a wind turbine and a parked yellow utility truck. Below, layered soil, rock and glittering ore veins cut through by dug tunnels, ladders and a lift shaft. Small workers in charcoal and hazard-yellow suits with glowing orange visors dig with drills, push a loaded mine cart and carry crates. A pocket of underground water on one side, a nest of large creature eggs in a side cave, and a glowing layer of lava at the very bottom.
Heroic portrait of five android specialists in color-coded gear standing in formation in front of a thriving futuristic city, connected worlds glowing in the sky, the leader holding a device.

Wide aerial view of a network of worlds and settlements, industrial, agricultural and research sites joined by glowing golden transit routes, planets and nebulae in the sky, a small team watching from a platform.
